newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia Producer Price Index rises 1.2 percent.
newsitem.headline: Colombia Producer Price Index rises 1.2 percent.

text.p: Colombia's Producer Price Index rose 1.2 percent in October compared with a 0.2 percent increase in the same month last year.
The accumulated total for the year to date is running at 13.3 percent, on a par with the index at this time last year.
October inflation figures are expected on Friday. The September figure took the nine-month inflation figure to 18.43 percent, above the 17 percent annual target set by the central bank.
Colombia's central bank said on Thursday that the index of goods produced and consumed in the country had risen by 1.4 percent in October, while the index for imported goods fell back 0.7 percent.
